title: Seeni
overview: A young woman and her family find their lives turned upside down when a series of unexpected and mysterious events begin unfolding around them, leading them into a situation far beyond anything they could have imagined.

title: Jailer 2
overview: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

title: Spying Stars
overview: Scientist Anandi visits Hanuman Island to perform the last rites ritual for her father. She is immediately placed in quarantine in a remote hotel due to a pandemic caused by a machine-dominant world. When a mysterious star starts following her, she escapes and seeks refuge with a mother and her transgender daughter.
